Were inputs CFU per mL or whole-culture counts? Specify effective culture/aliquot volumes, density conversions, dilution/partial-plating options, genotype-fraction corrections and any rounding of fractional estimates.
Please map founding colony/transformant/occasion identities, pregrowth genotype and any pre-existing reporter mutants, inoculum measurements, and whether CFUs correspond to single cells or clumps.
Please provide phase-specific growth/death and division-history measurements or the assumptions linking terminal population to divisions and mutation-event intensity.
For occasion1 SBW25rep5, reconcile H=7 counted candidates and M=8 sequenced colonies; identify all counted and sampled plates/colonies and the random-selection rule.
Please provide the absent Figure4A MPB38311 colony8 read or explanation and the denominator/missingness/resequencing mapping, preserving original records.
Specify recovery, post-plating mutation and colony-size criteria/control results, including the exactly100-visible-colonies rule if applied, and whether detection varies with genotype or clone age.
Provide the genotype/marker/occasion-specific reporter-mutant growth contract used by the estimator; no advantage is not necessarily equal growth.
What evidence calibrates the attTn7 reporter to native nlpD/site/phase conditions? Please distinguish the direct reporter estimate from native inference.
Please supply the public author-response bodies s010/s011 or a working official link. Current scoped network attempts did not acquire readable DOCX files.
